title: The per-zone loading gate at a hub's exit
oneLine: S._zoneLoading holds the player frozen at a hub exit while the next zone's art loads, with two failsafes.
topConcern: The 15 s cap lets the player in before the Wheel's preload ends; the orphaned load later rewrites the residency flag.

title: The one loading veil and today's town's art hold
oneLine: One DOM veil shared by the hub gate, town art hold, Wheel trip, dungeon opening and farm hold.
topConcern: Each hide checks different owners: a dungeon opening's late hide lifts the death trip's veil, showing unloaded today's town.

title: The trip down today's town's stairs into the Wheel's BroTown
oneLine: Login, death, dungeon and farm returns auto-walk the player down town's stairs into the Wheel.
topConcern: The 30 s clock lets go of the veil but not the trip; a re-armed gate past it loads today's town under the Wheel's veil.

title: The Wheel's ground worker and the trial's ready flag
oneLine: Ground worker start/ready/linger/stop and the _ready flag that tells the hub gate the Wheel is loaded.
topConcern: A stale preload sets _ready true after leaving; a failed worker start is cached while you stay, leaving sea, no doors, no Mayor.

title: Which Wheel the room plays (caps.wheelsize)
oneLine: Short or 5x Wheel, told by state_sync caps, raced against the worker's build; mismatch reloads the page.
topConcern: A second size change within two minutes is swallowed: the phone draws the wrong Wheel while claiming it draws both.

title: The zone change and its wipe, copied into a dozen places
oneLine: S.currentZone flipped by ~11 paths, each with its own list of zone-local state to clear.
topConcern: Wipe lists disagree; respawn, arena entry and dungeon-to-farm skip clearZoneLocalFx despite its 'every clear block' contract.

title: Hub exit gates and the Wheel's safe-ground hold
oneLine: Deaf trail-head latch, Mayor and unlock gates with banner throttles, level-band consent, Wheel commons clamp.

title: The Test panel's zone warp through the front doors
oneLine: S._devWarp walks an admin through hub doors leg by leg; needs World View exits.
topConcern: Unreachable in the Wheel world: the panel offers only WORLDVIEW_EXITS rows, which are empty.

title: A dungeon run on the phone: ask, open, arena, out
oneLine: Ten fields across five files track asking, the Wheel's 8 s opening, the arena, the clear and leaving.
topConcern: On a computer a second E during the opening replaces the run; the first then lifts the veil and unloads the shared floor.

title: After the clear: thirty seconds to pick up the loot
oneLine: S._dungeonClear counts 30 s then leaves, only if still in that same run.

title: The phone's own dungeon waves and depth tiers
oneLine: Pre-v2.3.1127 client-run waves, boss, rewards and depth warps; only against an old worker or behind if(false).
topConcern: Dormant: pays coins/XP on the phone and its 3 s warps never check the run is still current.

title: One trip into the Wheel that lands somewhere else
oneLine: _arriveAt: a 60 s one-shot landing point for the way back from a dungeon or the farm.

title: Each land's own music in the Wheel
oneLine: Debounced land music: fresh first answer, 1.2 s into a land, 8 s home, race music at once.

title: The sky's hour and the season
oneLine: Clock-derived day phase and Halloween week, with the Wheel's per-frame always-day override.

title: No man's land on the phone: level, skulls, lock
oneLine: Mirror of the worker's rings and fight rule plus own/peer skull and lock phases on the phone's clock.
topConcern: The renderer's threat-era rule shows a lapsed red skull as white for 10 minutes while the worker may still hold you red.

title: "Attack <name>?": the No man's land ask window
oneLine: One-window modal with per-peer asked/let-go/ignored memory and group-join rule, before any PvP blow.
topConcern: Large, five triggers and three memories decide one window; module-level _ask outlives zone changes until the card's interval.

title: No man's land explained before you step in, once
oneLine: Per-character told-once flag in localStorage and a pure due-now rule.

title: Lil Bro's race on the phone
oneLine: Explicit asked/count/run/done phase showing the worker's race, with timeouts on every wait.

title: Far players parked out of sight, looks that come with their players
oneLine: Per-peer parked phase (_away) and an unread no-look flag (_lookFar); online list freshness; map watch heartbeat.
topConcern: _lookFar is never read and any tick unparks, so a look-less 'Anon' copy can be shown in placeholder looks.

title: The crowd cap with a hold at the edge
oneLine: At most K others drawn in full, last frame's picks held for CROWD_HOLD more.

title: Your bro's emotes, moments and held poses
oneLine: Emote cooldown, timed moments and held poses mirrored to the worker's pose.
topConcern: Phone ends a pose at 4 px cumulative, worker at one 1.5 px step; after a deploy the worker's pose is gone.

title: A building's room picture warmed at its door
oneLine: Cap-of-one decoded room picture at the door you stand at, plus a one-way idle byte prefetch.

title: Noticing a stale bundle
oneLine: Polls /version.json every 5 min and on focus, stops at the first mismatch.

title: The first-join welcome, once and only for a new character
oneLine: Seen flag plus a 20 s wait for the worker's character before greeting; coach hold always released.

title: The Wheel's objects take hits, break and mend
oneLine: Per-object hit count, break, wait-for-you, mend; client-only by design, keyed to the worker's object list.

title: A dungeon's pictures and floor, loaded and let go
oneLine: Refcounted arena art records beside a floor picture freed by 'no zone names it'.
topConcern: The floor is outside the art's refcount: an overlapping opening unloads the floor the next arena is about to use.

title: Two map pins and the you-reached-it card
oneLine: Blue and red slots (row or place) with armed/asked flags, saved per character with v:2 and a migration.

title: The old lands' own mechanics: tide, diving, torch, echo, snow toys
oneLine: Per-zone timers and flags for tidal, hollows and frost, the closed old lands.
topConcern: Dormant: diving treasure credits coins on the phone, only in 'tidal' (?trial=off).

title: Wheel halls waiting for their worker; the farm trip's way back
oneLine: Caps-driven hall open/shut and a one-trip memo of where you left the Wheel for the farm.

title: Too far away over a resource, once a second
oneLine: Per-resource cooldown map with a 64-key cap for the 'Too far away' word.

title: The world trial's switch and readout
oneLine: Boot-time wheel/world/off mode kept per tab in sessionStorage; the 'world' island and manifest loader are retired.
topConcern: ?trial=off sticks for the whole tab, so a tester's later plain URLs keep showing the retired 'Town' map.

title: Freeing the zone you left, one beat late
oneLine: 400 ms / 1500 ms deferred frees of a left zone's map, variants and dungeon entry.
topConcern: They never re-check where you are when they fire, unlike the town timer; safe only because every way back is slower.
